title: Generalized datafeed Ingestion Core

verification.command: python3 -m py_compile product/data_core/ingestion.py product/data_core/local_cache.py product/data_core/authority_sink.py product/tests/test_ingestion_core.py

python3 -m py_compile product/data_core/contracts.py product/data_core/ingestion.py product/data_core/local_cache.py product/data_core/authority_sink.py product/tests/test_ingestion_core.py product/tests/test_data_contract.py

gotchas: raw capture is built before parse so parser failures retain auditable bytes
live adapter cached labels fail closed while retaining raw audit
local cache is degraded-only and never authority
non-publishable accepted records do not enter record receipts
fixture primary can fall through to a real fallback
document records must point at the same raw capture they are proven by
object storage upload before DB transaction can leave deterministic orphan blobs, which are retryable
fixture and cached data never promote to publishable records
